verse: Even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister. Mark 10:45.
title: Following Christ's Footprints of Service
bullets: Jesus came not to be served but to serve, and we honor Him by walking in His steps wherever there is human need.
The Golden Rule—treating others as we would want to be treated—is the standard by which we will be judged and the measure of true Christian living.
Our restless energy and spiritual gifts find their deepest purpose when poured out in selfless service to those around us, keeping our own hearts alive in Christ.

hymn.title: Lord, Whose Love in Humble Service

prayer: Lord, help me see Your face in every person I meet today, especially those who are suffering or forgotten. Give me the courage to step out of my comfort and serve with the same love and humility that Jesus showed, that my life might become a blessing to others and my own heart grow ever closer to You.
